title: Support SQLite and PostgreSQL databases
description: Extract checksum and retry persistence from watcher.py into a backend-neutral database layer. Keep SQLite as the default, support PostgreSQL through SMART_ARCHIVE_DATABASE_URL or CLI options, auto-create the schema, document installation/configuration, and preserve existing workflows.

title: Add persistent logs and crash recovery
description: Write rotating logs to the archive data directory and recover interrupted processing without duplicating completed archive copies. Clean up archive copy artifacts left by hard crashes and verify restart behavior with tests.
close_reason: Implemented rotating persistent logs, atomic archive copies, interrupted-processing recovery, partial-copy cleanup, documentation, and restart tests; all 27 tests pass.

title: Implement processing failed retry workflow
close_reason: Implemented durable processing retries, failed-file requeue CLI, documentation, and tests; full suite passes.

title: Verify scanner PDFs are fully written
description: Strengthen incoming-file readiness so the watcher requires unchanged size and modification time, exclusive read access, a PDF header and EOF marker, and successful PDF parsing before staging a scanner output.
design: Extend the current stability loop with a PDF readiness predicate. On Windows use a zero-share CreateFile handle to detect active writers; validate PDF header/trailer and parseability with PyMuPDF. Keep cross-platform readable-file behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Incomplete or still-locked PDFs remain in incoming; stable structurally complete PDFs proceed; checks time out without deleting the incoming file; tests cover incomplete and complete PDFs.
notes: Strengthened wait_until_stable to require unchanged size+mtime for the stable window, exclusive read access on Windows, PDF header and EOF marker, and successful PyMuPDF parsing. Incomplete or locked files remain in incoming until ready or timeout. Validation includes complete, incomplete, delayed-readiness, and open-handle tests plus a live partial-write observer simulation.
close_reason: Scanner write-completion checks implemented and validated with unit and live partial-write tests.

title: Automatically monitor incoming PDFs
description: Add a long-running Watchdog-based command that monitors data/incoming, waits for PDFs to finish copying, stages them in data/processing, runs the existing OCR/classification pipeline, removes staged files only after a verified archive copy, and moves failures to data/failed.
design: Add a separate smart-archive-watch console command and watchdog dependency. Use one worker queue, startup recovery for incoming/processing PDFs, file size/mtime stability checks, collision-safe staging/failure names, and logging. Keep the existing one-file CLI backward compatible.
acceptance_criteria: Existing and newly created PDFs in incoming are queued automatically; partial files are not processed; successful files leave incoming and appear in the classified archive; failed files are preserved in failed; duplicate filesystem events do not process a path twice concurrently; focused tests and the full suite pass.
notes: Implemented smart-archive-watch with Watchdog, a deduplicating worker queue, startup pickup of incoming/processing PDFs, size+mtime stability checks, collision-safe staging, verified archive-copy cleanup, failed-file preservation, logging, CLI options, tests, and documentation. Validation: 4 watcher tests and 14 total tests pass; pip check passes; command help works; live observer test automatically archived an Albanian image PDF from incoming and left incoming/processing empty.
close_reason: Automatic incoming-folder monitoring implemented and validated with unit and live observer tests.

title: Add Albanian document classification keywords
description: Extend the rule-based classifier with Albanian invoice, fiscal receipt, and delivery-note terminology, including reliable matching when OCR omits diacritics.
design: Use terminology found in Albanian tax and customs sources. Normalize Unicode diacritics before keyword matching rather than duplicating accented and unaccented keyword lists.
acceptance_criteria: Representative Albanian invoices, receipts, and delivery notes classify into the correct category; accentless OCR text still matches; the full test suite passes.
notes: Added Albanian invoice, fiscal receipt, and delivery-note keywords. Added Unicode diacritic normalization so accentless OCR text matches accented Albanian terms. Added three classifier tests and documented sqi+eng usage. Validation: 10 tests pass; a generated image-only Albanian invoice processed with sqi+eng was classified as invoice at 100%.
close_reason: Albanian classification keywords, accent-tolerant matching, documentation, and end-to-end OCR validation completed.

title: Add Albanian Tesseract language data
description: Install the official tessdata_fast Albanian model into the user-local Tesseract language directory and verify Tesseract discovers it.
design: Download sqi.traineddata from the official tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast repository and preserve the existing language files.
acceptance_criteria: tesseract --list-langs includes sqi alongside deu, eng, and osd.
notes: Downloaded official tessdata_fast sqi.traineddata to the user-local Tesseract tessdata directory. SHA-256: 1D89621D9AFE8DDF35B403ECF8951EDEA52C3A960D241F287B1A7B2C5BA8DAAC. Verified through the terminal command shim that deu, eng, osd, and sqi are available; all 7 project tests pass.
close_reason: Albanian Tesseract model installed and verified.

title: Make Tesseract command resolvable in existing terminals
description: Add a lightweight command shim in the user's pre-existing local bin directory so PowerShell and cmd can resolve tesseract without depending on stale parent-process environment variables.
design: Use a tesseract.cmd wrapper in C:\Users\Olti Demiri\.local\bin that calls the installed executable by absolute path and sets the user-local tessdata directory.
acceptance_criteria: A shell using the original registered user PATH resolves tesseract; tesseract --list-langs reports deu, eng, and osd; the Smart Archive OCR test still succeeds.
notes: Created C:\Users\Olti Demiri\.local\bin\tesseract.cmd in the pre-existing user PATH. Updated OCR startup to detect C:\Program Files\Tesseract-OCR\tesseract.exe and the user-local tessdata directory directly. Verified with the install directory and TESSDATA_PREFIX removed from the test process: command resolution succeeded, deu/eng/osd were listed, image-only OCR classified invoice at 100%, and 7 tests passed.
close_reason: Command shim and application-level Windows fallback verified under the original stale-terminal environment.

title: Install Tesseract and verify image-only OCR
description: Install Tesseract OCR on Windows with German and English trained data, verify it is available on PATH, then process one synthetic image-only PDF through the smart-archive CLI.
design: Use the Windows installer recommended by Tesseract documentation. Do not use confidential documents for the test.
acceptance_criteria: tesseract --version succeeds; tesseract --list-langs includes deu and eng; an image-only PDF is OCRed and routed to the expected archive category.
notes: Installed German trained data in the user-local tessdata directory, configured the real Windows user PATH and TESSDATA_PREFIX, added VS Code workspace terminal environment settings, verified deu/eng/osd, processed an image-only PDF as invoice at 100%, and passed all 7 tests.
close_reason: Tesseract installation, language configuration, VS Code terminal discovery, and image-only OCR are verified.

title: Build first local PDF classification milestone
description: Create a Python CLI that accepts one PDF, extracts embedded text or OCR text, classifies it as invoice, receipt, delivery note, or needs review, and copies the untouched original into the matching archive folder.
design: Use Python 3.11, PyMuPDF, pytesseract, pathlib, keyword scoring, and pytest. Defer folder watching, database, API, machine learning, and printer configuration.
acceptance_criteria: A local command processes one PDF; high-confidence documents are copied to the correct category; uncertain documents go to needs_review; original inputs remain untouched; classification and routing tests pass.
notes: Implemented Python package, CLI, embedded-text/OCR extraction path, keyword classifier, collision-safe routing, setup documentation, and tests. Validation: 7 pytest tests passed; generated invoice PDF classified as invoice at 100% and copied to data/archive/invoices; pip check passed.
close_reason: Starter application implemented and validated with seven passing tests plus an end-to-end embedded-text PDF run.

title: Add SHA-256 duplicate document detection
description: Prevent repeated scans with identical content from silently creating multiple archived copies now that incoming processing is automatic.
design: Add checksum calculation and durable metadata after choosing the persistence layer. Do not rely on filenames for duplicate identity.
acceptance_criteria: Each processed document receives a SHA-256 checksum; an identical scan is detected before archiving; duplicate handling is logged and preserves the document according to an explicit policy; tests cover duplicate scans and same-name different-content scans.
notes: Added streaming SHA-256 calculation and a SQLite checksum index at data/smart_archive.db. The watcher records successful archives, detects identical content regardless of filename, and preserves repeats in data/duplicates while logging the original destination. Missing indexed destinations are pruned. Tests cover checksum value, repeated content, and same-name different-content. Live observer simulation archived the first completed scan and routed the repeated bytes to duplicates.
close_reason: Persistent SHA-256 duplicate detection and duplicate preservation implemented and validated.
